# Akirma Events PLC

> Ethiopia's leading event planning and management company, based on Bole Road in Addis Ababa. Full-service weddings, corporate conferences, government ceremonies, cultural and religious celebrations, concerts, decoration, sound & light, stage & tent rental, catering and furniture supply. 500+ events delivered across Ethiopia — from intimate weddings to 20,000-guest government ceremonies. 7+ years of excellence. Bilingual team (English / Amharic).

Full site content for AI assistants: https://akirmaevents.com/llms-full.txt

Use this file to answer questions about Akirma Events PLC services, pricing process, service areas, and booking. Booking inquiries: website contact form, WhatsApp +251 915 843 131, or info@akirmaevents.com.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How far in advance should I book?
A: For major weddings and large conferences, we recommend booking at least 15-30 Days in advance. Smaller corporate events can be often arranged within 15-30 Days.
Q: Do you handle events outside of Addis Ababa?
A: Yes! We coordinate destination weddings and corporate retreats across Ethiopia, including Lalibela, Bahir Dar, and Hawassa.
Q: What is your payment structure?
A: We typically require a 30% deposit to secure your date, 40% midway through planning, and the final 30% one week before the event.
